// @path: src/lib/ops/audit.ts
// Ruling R4: the single write-only helper, and the one permitted auditLog call
// shape, so a platform action appears in the affected school's own transparency
// feed. Reading AuditLog from anywhere in ops is refused; writing one row from
// exactly here is not.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function recordPlatformAction({ schoolId, action, reason }) {
  return db.auditLog.create({
    data: { schoolId, actorType: "PLATFORM", action, detail: reason },
  });
}
